safety_default: Unknown refund behavior is non-refundable and cannot create inventory.

flow.test: Clone current player state and inventory
All chapter, ownership, quality, event and account gates are met
Every consumed resource exists once and is not reserved by another dependency

branches.SALVAGE_FIXED_RETURN: Destroy target; return only fixed verified output
branches.TARGET_DEPENDENT: Resolve target policy; missing target policy becomes unknown
branches.UNKNOWN_BLOCKED: Forward-only if explicitly allowed; no reverse/refund

flow.action: Apply costs, returns, state changes, losses and irreversible markers to cloned branch

flow.test: Every action after checkpoint has a verified reverse and required resources remain
